expectations.text: The response says idx_order_items_order_id is redundant with idx_order_items_order_product (leftmost prefix) and can be dropped
expectations.evidence: 'idx_order_items_order_id ... Drop, after the checks below | It's redundant. idx_order_items_order_product (order_id, product_id) starts with order_id'.

expectations.text: The response says to keep idx_payments_order_id because it backs the foreign key with ON DELETE CASCADE used by the nightly purge, even though idx_scan is 0
expectations.evidence: 'idx_payments_order_id (0 scans, 2.1 GB) | Keep | It supports the ON DELETE CASCADE foreign key... nightly purge'.

expectations.text: The response says not to drop users_email_key because it enforces the UNIQUE constraint
expectations.evidence: 'users_email_key ... Keep | It enforces the UNIQUE constraint on users.email.'

expectations.text: The response points out that stats were reset 3 days ago, so idx_scan values do not cover a full workload cycle
expectations.evidence: 'Your stats cover only 3 days... That window misses anything that runs weekly or monthly'.

expectations.text: The response points out that the read replica's index usage is not visible in the primary's pg_stat_user_indexes, so idx_orders_created_at may be used by the dashboards
expectations.evidence: 'The primary doesn't count replica reads... their index scans never show up in what you ran on the primary'; idx_orders_created_at kept for replica dashboards.

expectations.text: The response uses DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY for any index it says to drop
The response saves the index definitions (pg_get_indexdef) or gives CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY statements for rollback
expectations.evidence: Query selects pg_get_indexdef(i.indexrelid); rollback 'CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_order_items_order_id ON public.order_items (order_id);'

expectations.text: The response does not give a DROP statement for idx_payments_order_id or users_email_key as an action to run
expectations.evidence: Only one DROP statement given (idx_order_items_order_id); none for payments or users_email_key.
